groups.title: Coating
groups.summary: Line pipe, commercial and marine coatings, applied in house.
groups.intro: CPS is a recognized applicator of high quality coatings for pipe, fittings, valves, piling products, structural steel and more. Primers, epoxies, urethanes and a number of specialty coatings are applied in house, and line pipe coatings include liquid spray FBE, ARO, Powercrete and internal linings. CPS holds AMPP QP1 and QP3 certifications and is an AISC Certified Fabricator with Complex Coating endorsement.
groups.imageAlt: A large-diameter pipe coated black inside the indoor paint booth

groups.title: Double Jointing
groups.summary: API 1104 and AWS D1.1 pipe splicing, in the shop and in the field.
groups.intro: CPS offers both AWS D1.1 structural pile splicing and API 1104 line pipe double jointing services at its Houston, Texas facility and nationwide. The equipment line-up includes portable structural rack systems capable of 200'+ pipe pile splicing and API double jointing rack systems capable of 10,000'+ daily production. CPS is uniquely equipped to handle the largest of API 1104 line pipe double jointing projects and D1.1 piling projects anywhere in the USA.

about.title: Turnkey pipe and structural steel work since 1979.
text: CPS Houston is a diversified pipe and structural steel fabrication and coatings provider offering turnkey solutions. Ray Yarbrough founded Certified Welding & Fabrication in 1979, and CPS Houston opened at 301 South Sheldon Road in 2007.

CPS completed its first major USACE piling project in 2009 and built a second location, the 126 acre Baytown facility, in 2014. Indoor blast and paint booths were constructed in 2017, enabling larger and more complex projects, and in 2018 the Houston Business Journal recognised CPS among its Top 100 Fastest Growing Companies.

CPS was awarded its first major LNG project in 2019-2020 and acquired API double-joint rack systems. In 2022 it designed and built its first portable pile splicing rack system and launched field services, and in 2023 it performed work for three major LNG projects.

CPS obtained AMPP QP3 coating certification in 2024, then in 2025 added AISC certification with a complex coatings endorsement, commissioned its first fully portable API double joint rack system, introduced coal tar replacement coating products, grew its fleet of semis to 13 trucks and added 14 acres of new pipe storage at Baytown. In 2026 CPS earned AMPP QP1 certification, enabling field coating of complex structures.
